text.description_html:
Baldwin Estates Collection 5030 Knob

The classic design of this 1-3/4 inch diameter knob allows it to look beautiful in almost any setting. Made by Baldwin out of solid brass, you know that it is made with attention to both style and quality. This is a knob pair packaged without Rosettes.

Features and Specifications of the Baldwin 5030 Classic Knob Pair:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Knob Diameter: 1-3/4"

Sold Individually
